headline: NVD jumps 29.23% on 5.51x volume, leading the market's biggest 5‑day gain of +47.4%
market_take: Property stocks showed mixed signals with NVD soaring 29.23% on strong volume while KC fell 33.33% for its worst 5‑day move. Food sector saw sharp open gaps in AQUA (-9.09%) and XBIO (+16.67%) alongside a thin‑trade rally in F&D (+18.75%). REITs experienced extreme price gaps (M-PAT -100%) and notable volume spikes in AIMCG and ALLY. Several unusual‑trading alerts coincided with recent filings, especially TPOLY's asset‑sale notice and PRG's connected‑transaction disclosures.

sector_notes.note: NVD leads with +29.23% on 5.51x volume and a +47.4% 5‑day rise; KC drops -33.33% and filed a debt‑restructuring report on July 1.
AQUA opened down -9.09% and XBIO opened up +16.67%; F&D surged +18.75% to 52.25 despite zero volume, indicating thin trading.
M-PAT posted a -100% price gap; AIMCG and ALLY recorded volume spikes of 5.0σ and 6.4σ respectively, flagging heightened REIT activity.
STI showed a 10.0σ volume spike; TTCL is under a business rehabilitation hearing; PLE opened down -10.00%.
DCON opened up +5.56% and SCP logged a 6.0σ volume spike, suggesting renewed interest in construction materials.
